rationale: The Latin anchors *intumescere* (to swell up, become swollen) and *tumida æquora* (swollen/heaving waters) point clearly to physical swelling or expansion, as confirmed by the medical/herbal attestations (Herb., Lchdm.) where bodily swelling is the sense. swell.v.03 ("expand abnormally") best captures this concrete, physical sense of swelling, as opposed to the figurative pride sense (swell.v.02) or the general increase sense (swell.v.01).
